description: Image lazy loading and performance optimizations: add loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to user-uploaded images and avatars that appear below the fold.
steps: Step 1: Update web/components/common/avatar.tsx - add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` to the element that displays the avatar image. This covers all user avatars throughout the app (topic lists, comments, header, etc.).

Step 2: Update web/components/topic/topic-list-item.tsx - add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` to: (a) the topic image list items (the images in the grid at the bottom of type-1 topics), (b) the group icon images, (c) the node logo images.
Step 3: Update web/components/article/article-list.tsx - add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` to the article cover image ( with src={article.cover.preview || article.cover.url}).
Step 4: Update web/components/topic/comment-list.tsx - add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` to comment image list items (the images rendered in comment.imageList).
Step 5: Update web/app/routes/groups._index.tsx - add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` to group banner images and group icon images in both GroupCard and MyGroupCard components.
Step 6: Run `pnpm build` in web/ directory and confirm it builds successfully.
acceptance_criteria: Avatar img elements have loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
Topic list item images have loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
Article cover images have loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
Comment images have loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
Group card images have loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
verification: Run `pnpm build` in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/ and confirm exit code 0
findings: All 5 files updated successfully. Build passes without errors. Added loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to: avatar img (1), topic-list-item imgs (3), article-list img (1), comment-list img (1), groups page imgs (4 total - 2 banner + 2 icon across GroupCard and MyGroupCard).
